Jon: I'm blocked on eng-infra toggling LOG_KV_METRICS env var in staging — filed ticket #3842. Waiting on infra owner.

deploy-bot: Canary complete: canary-20240810-01 — error rate 0.2% (threshold 1.0%). Latency regression: none detected. :white_check_mark:

Mike: PR pushed: https://git.company/repo/pull/512 — ETA EOD Tue for tests.
Jon: infra ticket #3842 updated with owner @eng-infra; ETA Thu AM for flip. Will post when flipped.
Priya: Quick review done locally, left 2 nit comments. Overall looks safe to land after nit.

Anya: filing this thread as the coordination note for tomorrow standup. :thumbsup:
